discrepancies: Chart has Grok 3 at $15 in Feb 25 and Mar 25. Grok 3 was announced Feb 19 2025 with 'API coming soon' (https://x.ai/news/grok-3); the API launch is Apr 3 2025 (release notes, https://docs.x.ai/developers/release-notes). API flagship in Jan-Mar 2025 was Grok 2 at $10, so chart indexes 1 and 2 should be 10 if the chart tracks API availability.
Chart Jan 25 Grok 2 $10 agrees (official xAI launch post https://x.ai/news/grok-1212, Dec 12 2024: $2 in / $10 out).
Chart Mar 26 Grok 4.2 $6 agrees (grok-4.20 launched Mar 10 2026 at $2 in / $6 out). Chart Apr 26 $6 agrees.
Chart May 26 and Jun 26 Grok 4.3 $2.50 agree. Note grok-4.20 was also repriced from $6 to $2.50 at the same time (still listed at $2.50 on the live page).
Chart Jul 26 onward $6 agrees: Grok 4.5 (launch Jul 8), 4.6 (Aug 12), 4.7 (Sep 21) all $6 output below 200k prompt tokens ($12 above).
Chart has no mid or fast xAI tier; the Fast/mini tier ($0.50 output from Apr 2025 to Apr 2026) and Code tier ($1.50 then $2.00) are additions.
